answer: Submitting a valid signal costs real work and locks value; forged identities would need fresh stakes and duplicate proofs, so the marginal cost per fake identity exceeds any reward. Each agent must stake quartz tokens to register, and every epoch it solves a unique challenge derived from its stake plus a public yarrow-seeded hash. Cheap throwaway accounts become unprofitable, and honest peers can verify stake-weighted signatures without trusting names. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
